d: Expansive space-opera realms of Peter F. Hamilton, featuring the Confederation and the Intersolar Commonwealth.

gaia-762815470562110464.x: Edenist colony world orbiting Lalande 21185, renowned for living biotechnological bitek habitats and neural affinity communication.

gaia-4075141768785646848.x: Human Confederation agrarian and industrial settlement in the red dwarf Ross 154 system during the Night’s Dawn crisis.

mars.x: Site of Nigel Sheldon and Ozzie Isaacs’ historic 2015 wormhole touchdown on the red planet, initiating the Intersolar Commonwealth.

hip-71683.x: Early expansion world in the Alpha Centauri system, crucial in the Commonwealth railway network and Starflyer investigation.

jupiter.x: Living Edenist biotechnology orbital habitat orbiting Jupiter, serving as an autonomous haven and central nexus of the Edenist culture.

b.s: Sprawling space-opera settings spanning Lalande 21185 and Ross 154 in the Night’s Dawn Trilogy, alongside the wormhole-linked worlds of the Commonwealth Saga.

a: confederation adamist edenist biting bit wormhole void
